obstructions.name: Staircase room
obstructions.note: This room is centrally located on the terrace and will cast a shadow, reducing the area available for solar panels.

obstructions.name: Water tanks
obstructions.note: Two large water tanks are present on the terrace and will cast shadows, limiting where panels can be placed.

obstructions.name: Parapet walls
obstructions.note: The walls around the edge of the terrace will cast shadows, especially during the morning and late afternoon.

obstructions.name: Ventilation pipe
obstructions.note: A vertical pipe near the left parapet wall could obstruct panel placement or cast a small shadow.

obstructions.name: Nearby trees
obstructions.note: Trees surrounding the building could cast shadows on the terrace, particularly at certain times of the day.

obstructions.name: Surrounding buildings
obstructions.note: Other buildings in the neighborhood might cast shadows on the terrace depending on their height and the sun's position.

summary: The terrace has several obstructions including a staircase room, water tanks, and parapet walls that will cast shadows. Nearby trees and surrounding buildings could also cause shading on the terrace.
